originalIssue.rule: stays labelled unverified, never fixed, until reproduced under the ratified workload matrix

timelines.clock: server-process monotonic timestamps with internal phase spans

timelineLaw.correlation: spans correlate only through shared trace identity
timelineLaw.crossDomainComparison: raw timestamps from different clock domains are never differenced directly

phases.output: this evidence plan and the version-capture checklist
reproduction under the ratified workload matrix on a recorded reference machine, or a recorded failure to reproduce
attribution of the reproduced cost to client, server, provider, scheduler or publication
owned fixes with equal-work before/after evidence on the same basis
SLO re-measurement on the recorded machine; JBT1 owns the JetBrains harness; client-terminal claims require the actual clients

rawFailureRetention: all raw failed measurements are retained; anecdotal responsiveness claims are replaced by the constitution, not joined by it
